name: race_results_two_teams
description: A race's results (design 5.8, M6): a 2v2 Tide Race played to its end by caretakers on both hollows (the Bellfounder and the Beekeeper on my team, the Lamplighter and the Lookout on the rival's: since a crew of caretakers stacks every wave one of its plans lists, M8, the Lamplighter's crew stacks waves 2, 3 and 5 and clears wave 12 first, so it is the rival's), begun over an offline race of the session, so it ends on the session's results plate. Seed 3 plays it out one way, which the scenario pins first: the rival crew clears wave 12 while mine is still on it, so the simulation decides it on time against my team. The plate titles it from that outcome ('Your Rival Outran the Tide'), says the rule in one line ('Your rival cleared wave 12 first'), and shows one block per team, mine first: the rival's race time as the clock read on the tick it cleared wave 12, with a minute a life lost after it; mine where it got to and when ('on wave 12 at 6:25'); each team's lives and their line along its own waves, and its two players' rows, each with a line picked against its own team. The strings are written out here, not asked of the functions that make them (review of M6's race views: the checks compared the view with its own source, and the race time's format went unchecked when my crew had none).

steps.msg: both teams on the party strip, mine first

steps.assert: Session.state_name() == 'RESULTS' and shown['race'] and shown['outcome'] == Game.outcome() and Game.outcome() != ''
steps.msg: the results plate, with my team's outcome as the simulation decided it

steps.assert: rule == 'time' and Game.outcome() == 'lost' and Game.total_waves() == 12 and Game.sim.race_time(1) >= 0 and Game.sim.race_time(0) < 0 and Game.sim.hollows[0].wave == 12
steps.msg: seed 3's race: the rival crew cleared wave 12 while mine was still on it (the case the lines below hold; should the balance move it, pin the case this seed plays then)
the race's title from my team's outcome
the rule that decided it in one line

steps.assert: teams.size() == 2 and teams[0].begins_with('Your crew ') and teams[0].ends_with(': Sascha, Caretaker 1') and teams[1].begins_with('Rival crew ') and teams[1].ends_with(': Caretaker 2, Caretaker 3')
steps.msg: one block per team, mine first, each with its players

steps.assert: Game.sim.race_penalty_t(1) == 3600 * (20 - Game.sim.teams[1].lives) and Game.sim.race_time(1) == cleared + Game.sim.race_penalty_t(1)
steps.msg: the rival's race time is its clear tick plus a minute a life lost (M8's 3600 ticks)
and its block shows it as the clock read when it cleared wave 12, with what its lost lives add
my crew, with no race time: where it got to and when the race was decided

steps.assert: teams[0] == 'Your crew %s %d of 20 lives: Sascha, Caretaker 1' % [shown['teams'][0]['time'], Game.sim.teams[0].lives] and teams[1] == 'Rival crew %s %d of 20 lives: Caretaker 2, Caretaker 3' % [shown['teams'][1]['time'], Game.sim.teams[1].lives]
steps.msg: each block reads its time, its lives and its players

steps.assert: shown['teams'][0]['lives'] == Game.sim.teams[0].lives and shown['teams'][1]['lives'] == Game.sim.teams[1].lives and shown['teams'][0]['lives_line'].size() > 0 and shown['teams'][1]['lives_line'].size() > 0
steps.msg: each team's lives, and the line of them along its own waves

steps.assert: node('ResultsPanel').lines().size() == 4 and shown['rows'][0]['line'] != '' and shown['rows'][2]['line'] != '' and shown['rows'][0]['line'] != shown['rows'][1]['line'] and shown['rows'][2]['line'] != shown['rows'][3]['line']
steps.msg: a row each with its line, none twice within a team
